observes: normalize_vector pads [1,2]->[1,2,0,0], truncates 6->4, maps NaN/Inf->0.0 (no IRIS). On AUDITIB scratch IVGAudit.ib2_vec (VECTOR(FLOAT,4)), insert_vector stored a 3-wide input as 1,2,3,0, a 6-wide as 1,2,3,4 and NaN as 0, all returning True, while a raw INSERT of a 3-wide vector into the same column was refused (SQLCODE -104). Oracle = the helper's docstring (stated contract: coercion): pass. Shows the column-level width enforcement ADR-0005 relies on never fires through the helper; engine registry-aware refusal is tested upstream (tests/e2e/test_460_r223_vector_width_e2e.py), not re-run.
